Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 6, "heading": "CHAPTER 4. I FALL INTO DISGRACE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u006-b0030", "target": "Мы обедали одни, втроём. Он, казалось, был очень привязан к моей матери — боюсь, от этого он мне не стал милее, — а она была очень привязана к нему. Из их слов я понял, что к ним должна приехать погостить его старшая сестра и что её ждут в тот же вечер. Не уверен, узнал ли я тогда или позднее, что он, не занимаясь активно никаким делом, имел долю в лондонской торговле винами или получал ежегодную часть её прибылей — этот торговый дом был связан с его семьёй со времён его прадеда, и у сестры в нём был такой же интерес; но я упомяну об этом здесь, так или иначе.", "source_sha256": "a43fe6108e0d87fb32c129f9af8a7080ff7607a9a166d45c87c1db1f64454172", "target_id": "ru-en85-u006-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "c869eb9e0f0f58abc07a85e3e26582b129fa70183168a1991f3aea3a50197e98"}, {"source_id": "en85-u006-b0031", "target": "После обеда, когда мы сидели у камина и я обдумывал, как бы улизнуть к Пегготи, не решаясь, однако, ускользнуть, чтобы не обидеть хозяина дома, к садовой калитке подкатила карета, и он вышел встретить гостью. Мама последовала за ним. Я робко шёл за нею, но у дверей гостиной, в сумерках, она обернулась и, обняв меня, как привыкла это делать, прошептала, чтобы я любил моего нового отца и был ему послушен. Она сделала это торопливо и тайком, как будто это было дурно, но нежно; и, протянув руку назад, держала в ней мою, пока мы не подошли к месту, где он стоял в саду; тогда она выпустила мою руку и продела свою под его локоть.", "source_sha256": "3dd546c1c1e3df570f056221ec20b820155fae8bb70efdeeae50f2886d066116", "target_id": "ru-en85-u006-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "b8755e749dd143a630b36f6a28df09028eba4e3915ce48a728c048a5d514cbfa"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 4, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u006-b0032", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was Miss Murdstone who was arrived, and a gloomy-looking lady she was; dark, like her brother, whom she greatly resembled in face and voice; and with very heavy eyebrows, nearly meeting over her large nose, as if, being disabled by the wrongs of her sex from wearing whiskers, she had carried them to that account. She brought with her two uncompromising hard black boxes, with her initials on the lids in hard brass nails. When she paid the coachman she took her money out of a hard steel purse, and she kept the purse in a very jail of a bag which hung upon her arm by a heavy chain, and shut up like a bite. I had never, at that time, seen such a metallic lady altogether as Miss Murdstone was.", "sha256": "c0c6323a151016d0e41a7a77b3068cb378b00e17179898bea22df54dbda3e84f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[32]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0033", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She was brought into the parlour with many tokens of welcome, and there formally recognized my mother as a new and near relation. Then she looked at me, and said:", "sha256": "4378ea62aca7d40a2ea477c8b254983104b4b2022073be2ce6902b151e01411b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[33]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0034", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is that your boy, sister-in-law?’", "sha256": "530ae9e28b0f55c7a1082e0d09e9849bd98392d68dba936868242a691485aac8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[34]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0035", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "My mother acknowledged me.", "sha256": "18579f18c2d8d986f1ef019da6fb5a8c999bdbde877927e7aa92d27400e75a1a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[35]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0036", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Generally speaking,’ said Miss Murdstone, ‘I don’t like boys. How d’ye do, boy?’", "sha256": "384f495421052d11d0c6529be37580fed762d419933eb742e0c54d7acecaade3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[36]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0037", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Under these encouraging circumstances, I replied that I was very well, and that I hoped she was the same; with such an indifferent grace, that Miss Murdstone disposed of me in two words:", "sha256": "47c98533f1d92601020e9f1dc6167cf57491d2b936ca818e9902b6e2d6f6c25e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[37]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0038", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Wants manner!’", "sha256": "6a9c053d74ddb5432b5ae52e89a475abab16e7fafd703aabb00221df0c7e8610", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[38]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0039", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Having uttered which, with great distinctness, she begged the favour of being shown to her room, which became to me from that time forth a place of awe and dread, wherein the two black boxes were never seen open or known to be left unlocked, and where (for I peeped in once or twice when she was out) numerous little steel fetters and rivets, with which Miss Murdstone embellished herself when she was dressed, generally hung upon the looking-glass in formidable array.", "sha256": "11505324b18cf934f23804f1cf23d0386beac4529004bc198796f6d58d516014", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[39]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0040", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "As well as I could make out, she had come for good, and had no intention of ever going again. She began to ‘help’ my mother next morning, and was in and out of the store-closet all day, putting things to rights, and making havoc in the old arrangements. Almost the first remarkable thing I observed in Miss Murdstone was, her being constantly haunted by a suspicion that the servants had a man secreted somewhere on the premises. Under the influence of this delusion, she dived into the coal-cellar at the most untimely hours, and scarcely ever opened the door of a dark cupboard without clapping it to again, in the belief that she had got him.", "sha256": "65d521b7eeb7632470e1e90b3ef9886ced47a01b23d15bede3c835209e227044", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[40]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0041", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Though there was nothing very airy about Miss Murdstone, she was a perfect Lark in point of getting up. She was up (and, as I believe to this hour, looking for that man) before anybody in the house was stirring. Peggotty gave it as her opinion that she even slept with one eye open; but I could not concur in this idea; for I tried it myself after hearing the suggestion thrown out, and found it couldn’t be done.", "sha256": "5abe7ced8f00a09e3d95b32501a9755c44b1c5844cca4b607cb7a6def0a78908", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[41]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0042", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "On the very first morning after her arrival she was up and ringing her bell at cock-crow. When my mother came down to breakfast and was going to make the tea, Miss Murdstone gave her a kind of peck on the cheek, which was her nearest approach to a kiss, and said:", "sha256": "eeb19fc7eeca142519670e28e407e420cc8e895a7cc72b60fe953df89bc59f15", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[42]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0043", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Now, Clara, my dear, I am come here, you know, to relieve you of all the trouble I can. You’re much too pretty and thoughtless’—my mother blushed but laughed, and seemed not to dislike this character—‘to have any duties imposed upon you that can be undertaken by me. If you’ll be so good as give me your keys, my dear, I’ll attend to all this sort of thing in future.’", "sha256": "0efcea0677da06665b6c061868d0dc2540deb56f68b6d5d7583d6413e7441613", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[43]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0044", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "From that time, Miss Murdstone kept the keys in her own little jail all day, and under her pillow all night, and my mother had no more to do with them than I had.", "sha256": "4c82d700987596aae00ed95bcdaef2704af031bc9814b81e3c624b812ba0e509", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[44]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0045", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "My mother did not suffer her authority to pass from her without a shadow of protest. One night when Miss Murdstone had been developing certain household plans to her brother, of which he signified his approbation, my mother suddenly began to cry, and said she thought she might have been consulted.", "sha256": "650e32d932e00a739a5903d1d3fc8fe9ce6002afb27dd8d898aaf1b7b97054d2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[45]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0046", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Clara!’ said Mr. Murdstone sternly. ‘Clara! I wonder at you.’", "sha256": "9dd6b9691d1df9f6eb0d2507426ad1b57b90ed205b6a63caa6a5af8365c692da", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[46]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0047", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, it’s very well to say you wonder, Edward!’ cried my mother, ‘and it’s very well for you to talk about firmness, but you wouldn’t like it yourself.’", "sha256": "ee98271222cad66c27c750fe0fa89bf1ded02c7d5b135fa1b1ddc75f93b85dd2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[47]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0048", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Firmness, I may observe, was the grand quality on which both Mr. and Miss Murdstone took their stand. However I might have expressed my comprehension of it at that time, if I had been called upon, I nevertheless did clearly comprehend in my own way, that it was another name for tyranny; and for a certain gloomy, arrogant, devil’s humour, that was in them both. The creed, as I should state it now, was this. Mr. Murdstone was firm; nobody in his world was to be so firm as Mr. Murdstone; nobody else in his world was to be firm at all, for everybody was to be bent to his firmness. Miss Murdstone was an exception. She might be firm, but only by relationship, and in an inferior and tributary degree. My mother was another exception. She might be firm, and must be; but only in bearing their firmness, and firmly believing there was no other firmness upon earth.", "sha256": "d9930f6fb409f00e10b98275f102f8f907dd9003f27e28b04cafc086e5dea069", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[48]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0049", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It’s very hard,’ said my mother, ‘that in my own house—’", "sha256": "bef15cedd67956b100f5fe27e341fa0fef6aba1ca4be947c1f4cd4f4b5eb852d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[49]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0050", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My own house?’ repeated Mr. Murdstone. ‘Clara!’", "sha256": "5f2f84494c5b2983bdbea5bdbb168a18b138e0a7773c243a8e2bc2e21998fca0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[50]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0051", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘OUR own house, I mean,’ faltered my mother, evidently frightened—‘I hope you must know what I mean, Edward—it’s very hard that in YOUR own house I may not have a word to say about domestic matters. I am sure I managed very well before we were married. There’s evidence,’ said my mother, sobbing; ‘ask Peggotty if I didn’t do very well when I wasn’t interfered with!’", "sha256": "81c5e43867a88bbf5905560aa409c354d24522c4fa5370214df8dae49f6f03e8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[51]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0052", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Edward,’ said Miss Murdstone, ‘let there be an end of this. I go tomorrow.’", "sha256": "033e1a8d08760f598e6754537659702959164d1e652e7c9ffb0ee3456bcfbfce", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[52]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0053", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Jane Murdstone,’ said her brother, ‘be silent! How dare you to insinuate that you don’t know my character better than your words imply?’", "sha256": "11e058df94fb3d3dd32e7ac8a26e8094cacb905f8d917d7ada1e39adbf4f4545", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[53]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0054", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am sure,’ my poor mother went on, at a grievous disadvantage, and with many tears, ‘I don’t want anybody to go. I should be very miserable and unhappy if anybody was to go. I don’t ask much. I am not unreasonable. I only want to be consulted sometimes. I am very much obliged to anybody who assists me, and I only want to be consulted as a mere form, sometimes. I thought you were pleased, once, with my being a little inexperienced and girlish, Edward—I am sure you said so—but you seem to hate me for it now, you are so severe.’", "sha256": "cf621c2e953b543b7ce3fe6a94eb370af43602c0e5cd5f3320a96f5dd209c4a4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[54]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0055", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Edward,’ said Miss Murdstone, again, ‘let there be an end of this. I go tomorrow.’", "sha256": "22050f85bc48fe3819b1076b1a61bdeb2f8f1a6e63995837ba4b75fe982eb020", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[55]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0056", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Jane Murdstone,’ thundered Mr. Murdstone. ‘Will you be silent? How dare you?’", "sha256": "5caff5452a08b745a0e5c7fbe07c58a1261ec49ea38f31fb6c8f0c064b1569b2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[56]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0057", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Miss Murdstone made a jail-delivery of her pocket-handkerchief, and held it before her eyes.", "sha256": "8022c49fc40f7368dda3a6be704dfc40dc994d702ca07b10ae4e28b554d1b65a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[57]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0058", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Clara,’ he continued, looking at my mother, ‘you surprise me! You astound me! Yes, I had a satisfaction in the thought of marrying an inexperienced and artless person, and forming her character, and infusing into it some amount of that firmness and decision of which it stood in need. But when Jane Murdstone is kind enough to come to my assistance in this endeavour, and to assume, for my sake, a condition something like a housekeeper’s, and when she meets with a base return—’", "sha256": "76d46dc155f762befa825e4b88945cbcbb94e19c9aab2457e183f620ef4eb3e8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[58]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0059", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, pray, pray, Edward,’ cried my mother, ‘don’t accuse me of being ungrateful. I am sure I am not ungrateful. No one ever said I was before. I have many faults, but not that. Oh, don’t, my dear!’", "sha256": "e472c95fc8a23968b778f4ee9b41be3a17ef18cc919d3ffbfa7519792095a999", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[59]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘When Jane Murdstone meets, I say,’ he went on, after waiting until my mother was silent, ‘with a base return, that feeling of mine is chilled and altered.’", "sha256": "8a7d104dc994e80e7be2331c7876cab3ff5e4b9dfb27f1b5883759ed68b9805e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Don’t, my love, say that!’ implored my mother very piteously. ‘Oh, don’t, Edward! I can’t bear to hear it. Whatever I am, I am affectionate. I know I am affectionate. I wouldn’t say it, if I wasn’t sure that I am. Ask Peggotty. I am sure she’ll tell you I’m affectionate.’", "sha256": "6581446c47af5906298cab45843b10250180ea4d5265c9b7645438ea07354fd9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘There is no extent of mere weakness, Clara,’ said Mr. Murdstone in reply, ‘that can have the least weight with me. You lose breath.’", "sha256": "fd07412e1d3a4866d41e283f9153abd815fdf0f6c44ed975d36362e4567e7cd1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Pray let us be friends,’ said my mother, ‘I couldn’t live under coldness or unkindness. I am so sorry. I have a great many defects, I know, and it’s very good of you, Edward, with your strength of mind, to endeavour to correct them for me. Jane, I don’t object to anything.
